ALTERNATE

name: the great work
types: enchantment saga
chapter: I — CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target opponent and each creature they control.
chapter: II — create three treasure tokens.
chapter: III — until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard. if a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. exile CARDNAME, then return it to the battlefield.
replacement: CARDNAME enters with a lore counter on it.
